subject: Re: Rossum Bank evaluation — MAP items: SOC 2 / SIG-CAIQ / DPA / retention
messages:
From: Daniel Simmons <d.simmons@rossumbank.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com; markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Maria Gomez <m.gomez@rossumbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Rossum Bank evaluation — initial MAP & security asks

Hi Irene / Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — Rossum Bank leadership liked the latency/cost profile. Our legal and security teams want to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) before we proceed to the POC. A few items they asked us to confirm up-front:

- SOC 2 status and expected delivery date for the Type II report (we need a summary and any carveouts).
- SIG / CAIQ evidence or self-assessment matrix — they want a completed CAIQ or a plan (which questions will be answered by Demo stage vs. later).
- DPA redlines: we will share a first pass. Can Redwood accept EU data residency commitments and a 90-day deletion SLA for transient inference logs?
- Data escrow / long-term archival: if we require an escrow for model artifacts or logs, what options and timelines exist?

High level timing: Rossum wants a commercial decision by end of November; security must sign off on MAP gating items by Nov 12 in order to keep that calendar.

Can you confirm the items above and propose who from your side will own each deliverable (SOC2 attestation, CAIQ completion, DPA redline review, retention/escrow options)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Daniel Simmons
CTO, Rossum Bank
---
References: Rossum evaluation kickoff deck attached to the demo (internal).

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Daniel Simmons <d.simmons@rossumbank.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <m.gomez@rossumbank.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T09:30:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Rossum Bank evaluation — initial MAP & security asks

Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Looping Jordan (partner lead) and Markus (security lead) to own the respective deliverables. Below is a proposed MAP fragment focused on your gating items; I attached a quick spreadsheet (RB_MAP_v1.xlsx) with dates/action owners.

Summary answers up-front:
- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II; we can send a redacted report and a 1-page evidence summary. Expect the redacted PDF by Oct 26. (Owner: Markus Klein)
- SIG / CAIQ: We maintain a completed CAIQ for our service; we'll provide the completed CAIQ export plus a short Q/A indicating any controls we expect to answer post-POC. Target: Oct 28 (Owner: Jordan Blake)
- DPA / Residency: We can commit to EU-only inference processing for the Rossum tenant and a 90-day deletion SLA for inference logs. We need to confirm archival windows for analytics-level aggregates; propose to capture that in the DPA redline discussion.
- Escrow / Archival: We offer an archival escrow option (third-party escrow; 30-day retrieval SLA) — pricing/terms will be an addendum. Draft options included in the spreadsheet.

Action items (from MAP spreadsheet):
1) Redwood: deliver redacted SOC2 + 1-page summary — Oct 26 — Markus
2) Redwood: CAIQ export + Q/A — Oct 28 — Jordan
3) Rossum: send DPA redlines — Oct 25 — Daniel / Maria
4) Joint: call to confirm residency/deletion semantics and escrow scope — propose Oct 29, 10:00 CET (30 min)

If the dates above work, we'll formalize the MAP and slot in the canary/POC start date the week of Nov 8 (contingent on security signoff by Nov 12).

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0102

Attachment: RB_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: MAP milestones, owners, delivery dates)

From: Maria Gomez <m.gomez@rossumbank.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com; jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Simmons <d.simmons@rossumbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Rossum Bank evaluation — initial MAP & security asks

Irene / Jordan — thanks for the plan and proposed owners. A couple of clarifications from our security/legal review after seeing your note: 

- SOC 2: we will need the Type II report redacted for customer distribution (no sensitive client names). Please confirm whether your SOC 2 covers hosted API and dedicated deployments — Rossum intends to run in a dedicated tenant.
- CAIQ: great — please mark any "partial" answers where evidence requires a dedicated-tenant configuration. Our security lead also flagged two CAIQ items around key management (HSM / customer-managed keys) and log segregation. Can you indicate whether these are covered out-of-the-box or would require an addendum?
- DPA redlines: attached (Rossum_DPA_redlines_v1.docx). Key asks are: EU-only processing clause (App A), 90-day deletion SLA (App B), and a limited subprocessor list / notification window.
- Retention & Escrow: we expect clear retention schedules for (a) inference logs (90d), (b) model artifacts (customer-owned; escrow only if required), and (c) analytics / aggregate telemetry (up to 24 months). If escrow is priced separately, please send options.

Two asks: 1) please confirm SOC 2 scope for dedicated mode by the Oct 26 delivery, and 2) mark CAIQ items that change when operating dedicated vs. hosted. If we can get those by EOD Oct 28 we can keep the Nov 12 security gating timeline.

Best,
Maria Gomez
Head of Security Operations — Rossum Bank
Attachment: Rossum_DPA_redlines_v1.docx

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Maria Gomez <m.gomez@rossumbank.com>; Daniel Simmons <d.simmons@rossumbank.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com; jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T16:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Rossum Bank evaluation — initial MAP & security asks

Maria / Daniel — I’m Markus (Head of Security & Compliance at Redwood). Quick responses and a proposed close-path to keep your Nov 12 gating date: 

1) SOC 2 scope: our current SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted Redwood API and our control plane. For dedicated tenants we provide a scoped addendum — the controls map is equivalent; we will supply a scoped SOC attestation letter for dedicated deployments by Nov 5.

2) CAIQ: we will deliver the completed CAIQ export by Oct 28 and annotate items that differ for dedicated tenants (KMS, network segmentation, log segregation). For HSM/customer-managed keys — we support customer-managed keys via KMS integration in Dedicated; that will be flagged as "requires configuration" rather than a product gap.

3) DPA redlines: we received Rossum_DPA_redlines_v1.docx. We accept EU-only processing and the 90-day deletion SLA for inference logs in our standard form for Dedicated tenants; a limited subprocessor list and 30-day notification window are acceptable. We will return a draft DPA with tracked changes by Nov 2.

4) Escrow & retention: options — (A) standard escrow (deposit to third-party escrow; retrieval 30 days), (B) premium escrow + retrieval SLA (7 days) — pricing addendum will be sent by Nov 3. Analytics aggregates retention at 24 months is acceptable; we'll include that in the DPA appendix.

Next steps (short checklist):
- Oct 28: CAIQ + annotations (Jordan)
- Nov 2: Tracked DPA draft back to Rossum (Markus)
- Nov 3: Escrow pricing and addendum (Irene)
- Nov 5: Scoped SOC attestation letter for Dedicated (Markus)
- Nov 9: final MAP sign-off draft to Rossum legal

If you'd like to short-circuit with a 30-min working session, we can do Nov 1 or Nov 4; otherwise we'll proceed on the dates above.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
